digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Monday, August 24, with eight timed calendar entries, three urgent items, and one carry-over. The day turns on making the Amazon Connect UAT go/no-go call in the 10:30 AM standup, assigning coverage for Sara's Criminal Research and Knowledge Management work, and entering the late portfolio and Contigo meetings ready to name owners and decisions. Amazon Connect remains the clearest blocker: technical fixes, skills-based routing, production user/security ownership, and the FirstFire scope still need a single decision path before tomorrow's UAT kickoff. A suspicious external security email should be reported without opening its link. Dashboard state was last modified Friday, so completion signals may not reflect any weekend changes.

items.label: Make the Amazon Connect UAT go/no-go decision
items.detail: Use the 10:30 AM SVC standup to confirm whether Salesforce Support's technical fixes and skills-based routing are ready for tomorrow's kickoff. The tester roster and queues exist, but production user/security ownership, the FirstFire task list, personas, and remaining routing dependencies still need a single accountable plan.

items.label: 8:00-9:00 AM - Approve timecards and set the week
items.detail: Close timecard approvals and frame the decisions that must be settled while Sara is out.

items.label: 9:00-10:00 AM - Focus window
items.detail: Use the clean hour for Sara's project assignments and Amazon Connect go/no-go preparation.

items.label: 10:00-11:00 AM - Legal and SVC back-to-back
items.detail: Legal Change Management flows directly into the SVC standup. Carry a short owner-and-dependency list, with the UAT readiness decision as the priority output.

items.label: Noon-2:00 PM - Protected work window
items.detail: Blocked space at noon plus an open 1:00 PM hour provide the best runway to close morning follow-ups and prepare the portfolio stack.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - Portfolio, Maria, and MHE
items.detail: BD Portfolio Review is followed by Maria at 3:00 PM and the RFE MHE timeline review at 3:30 PM. Capture blockers, owner decisions, and timeline changes in one running log.

items.label: 4:30 PM - Contigo Plan pilot alignment
items.detail: Set the interim routing, 30-minute attorney handoff, coverage, language support, volume thresholds, and owners for the detention-prevention pilot.

items.label: Set project coverage while Sara is out
items.detail: With Jorge and Eugenia, confirm Preparers' Certification capacity before assigning Criminal Research, choose a PM for Knowledge Management, and keep Biometrics in assessment until Jill's priority guidance establishes whether inflight work must move.

items.label: Lock the Contigo pilot routing and coverage model
items.detail: Use the 4:30 PM alignment to confirm the interim Detention IVR route, the CSC-to-Phase 2 attorney handoff within 30 minutes, hours and language coverage, volume monitoring, and the threshold for revisiting staffing.

items.label: Report the suspicious security email
items.detail: An unread external message titled 'Microsoft Security Update' urges a software download from an unrelated sender domain. Do not open its link; report it through the firm's phishing or security process.

items.label: Sara Watson is out through Friday
items.detail: Her calendar shows August 24-28 out of office. Route project assignments and approval questions through the coverage decisions named in her Friday email.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Jhara 1:1 conflicts with SVC standup
items.detail: Both meetings occupy the same 30-minute slot. Decide today whether UAT stabilization or the portfolio-roadblock discussion gets Jean's attendance and arrange coverage for the other.

items.label: 2:00 PM - Amazon UAT kickoff conflicts with EPMO lead catch-up
items.detail: The one-hour UAT launch overlaps the EPMO TL Weekly Catch Up. Resolve attendance and decision coverage before the kickoff, then preserve the 3:30 PM Nicolas 1:1 and 4:00 PM Asana checkpoint.
